g.text: Share of untied units whose decreased signature had the larger cellulose annotation share, with exact 95% intervals; 0.5 means no preference.

Experiments within a study are not independent; the study rows collapse them to one vote per study. Disease-vs-healthy rows keep experiments the contrast manifest classifies disease_vs_healthy, relabelled so

decreased means lower in disease. Intervals are exact (Clopper–Pearson for shares; conditional maximum likelihood for odds ratios). PD, Parkinson's disease; HIV, HIV infection; CRC, colorectal cancer. BugSigDB
2026-04-24_00:41_UTC; human profiles; condition and body site from each experiment's own record.
